checks.name: Backend verify incl. MealIntegrationTest (PostgreSQL + S3 emulator)
Clean-clone workspace incl. contract lint/drift and registry parity

scenario_results.observed: MealIntegrationTest: a draft without an allergen declaration gets 422 naming allergenDeclaration REQUIRED on PUBLISH, stays DRAFT and its public detail is 404; a bare draft's 422 lists every missing requirement (Arabic description/portion/ingredients, declaration, price, approved photo); CONTAINS without codes, codes with NONE_DECLARED, price 0, fractional price (400), unknown allergen code (400), a client kitchenId (400), another cook's or a pending photo (PHOTO_NOT_APPROVED) are refused; a kitchen that cannot sell gets 409 KITCHEN_UNAVAILABLE and its published meals disappear publicly until restored. Mutations removing the declaration requirement, the kitchen check and the public selling filter each failed a test.

Editing a published meal's price and allergens creates revision 2 while revision 1 keeps 9500 piastres and GLUTEN only; stale versions are 409; a no-op edit adds no revision; a published meal cannot drop its photos; archiving removes it from public access, makes it read-only and keeps revisions; the database rejects updating or deleting meal_revision rows and deleting meals. Orders and reorder do not exist yet: order items must copy MealService.revision snapshots (MB-017/MB-019), where history and reorder are re-tested.

Meal CRUD with Arabic/English fields, portion, ingredients and explicit allergens; versioning; publication guards; archive semantics; public MealDetail per the core DTO (Arabic default, English via Accept-Language with Vary, NONE_DECLARED as explicit code) without owner identity, private location, contact, status or version, versus the cook DTO with content, status and version; owner scope (other cook 404, non-cook 403, anonymous 401) and keyset pagination with search.

findings: Self-review: the first public DTO diverged from the MB-007 core MealDetail contract; reworked to the documented DTO instead of changing the contract. Spring's default locale fallback (JVM locale) would have served English by default; Accept-Language is now parsed explicitly with Arabic default.
Proposed defaults recorded in docs: Arabic content required to publish, English optional; 14 allergen codes; price 1..1,000,000 piastres; up to 6 photos.

Residual: nextSlots/availability (MB-015/016) and rating summaries (MB-024) are placeholders with truthful values (empty, UNAVAILABLE, 0); order history and reorder (TC-012 full path) are re-tested in MB-017/MB-019; moderation is MB-023.
Residual: the cook meal list loads photos per row (bounded by limit 100); revisit with discovery performance work (MB-016).
